name: Mailjet
description: Send emails through the Mailjet email delivery service.

fields.name: fromEmail
fields.description: The email address that emails are sent from. Make sure it is a verified sender in Mailjet.

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: The name shown as the sender of the emails.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description: The Mailjet API key used to authenticate requests, found under Account settings / API Key Management.

fields.name: secretKey
fields.description: The secret key that pairs with the API key. Mailjet requires both to authenticate.
